scenario_scope: Scenario IDs describe only the concrete checks in the linked test, not proof that all required transports or all universal assertions for the scenario have been exercised.

precise_assertions.credentials: Independent passwords; login identities and tokens; invalid password and unknown username produce no token; logout revokes only that session; disable and re-enable revoke both active sessions; administrator reset revokes both and rejects old password.
precise_assertions.profiles: Self update and other-user path denial, with conflicting body, query, and header; read back both accounts; user_metadata inspected while runtime stopped; roles and admin API remain unprivileged.
precise_assertions.admin: Generated REST operations across ordinary, channel founder, oper-role and anonymous actors for list, disable, reset and grant; compare target account before/after and confirm original password; root performs listing, role grant/revoke, disable/enable; inspect users and account_roles after shutdown.
precise_assertions.dm: Three unique IRC messages; inspect actual participant and nonparticipant IRC clients after barriers, read participant histories and reject explicit Alice/Bob and Bob/Charlie impersonation queries including administrator; inspect all three messages in SQLite after shutdown.
precise_assertions.roles: Creates all named accounts through registration and logs in; grants oper/bot via root admin REST; auto-registered founder and channel modes +a/+o/+h/+v and ban observed in real IRC; disabled and logged-out credentials rejected. Revoked credential covers the requested expired/revoked alternative; expiry itself is untested.
precise_assertions.broadcast: Ordinary account denied broadcast on both administrative routes; two connected recipients see no forbidden broadcast after barriers; authorized root broadcast received by both; root stats succeeds and ordinary stats is denied.
precise_assertions.identity_substitution: Separate URL denial, body, query and header substitution cases independently check authorized self-write, other and unrelated profiles, and user_metadata SQLite state after stop.
precise_assertions.nicknames: NickServ GROUP and DROP own nickname; changing to Bob nickname and dropping Bob nickname are rejected; admin REST and stopped SQLite confirm registrations.
precise_assertions.principal: NickServ IDENTIFY and SASL PLAIN each produce alice 900, SASL connects Alice to a secret channel, and Alice REST can access it while Bob cannot.
precise_assertions.expiration: Fault fixture adjusts exactly one SHA-256 token-hash session expiry while workerd is stopped; expired device gets 401 after restart and independent sessions remain valid.
precise_assertions.admin_inventory: 40 method/path/body combinations on /admin and /api/v1/admin, for Alice, Bob, founder, operator, oper role, logged-out and anonymous; compare stopped-runtime users, roles, SCRAM, nicknames, permissions, channel metadata and messages before and after; active IRC operator observes no broadcast after a barrier. Positive operations exercised separately and remaining gaps listed.
precise_assertions.admin_state: Root provisions, updates, reads, disconnects and deletes a managed account; reads and changes channel registration, information and bot settings; writes and deletes user/channel metadata, changes signup config and archives a channel. Runtime restart confirms channel information and bot settings.
precise_assertions.dm_restart: Three conversations survive full workerd stop and restart; participant reads still succeed and explicit unauthorized query stays denied.
precise_assertions.dm_mutation: IRC author message ID; recipient and third party edits and redactions rejected; author edit and redaction delivered to Bob; stopped SQLite excludes forged and redacted payload.
precise_assertions.dm_history: Alice CHATHISTORY and Bob HistServ replay own DM; Charlie and administrator replay Bob without Alice/Bob message; public channel observer receives no private marker; search for the hyphenated marker succeeds and result items do not contain the private message.
precise_assertions.preauth: NICK/USER plus JOIN and PRIVMSG to channel and Bob; error 451, no 001 or JOIN, Bob sees no marker after barrier, and stopped SQLite excludes marker.
precise_assertions.offline: Authenticated sender PRIVMSG to a registered offline nickname returns IRC 401; recipient history and SQLite contain no message. There is no REST send route in server/routes/api/v1/dms.
precise_assertions.admin_irc_events: Administrator KICK, TOPIC and MODE delivered once to intended IRC members and not outsider; kicked account loses private-channel REST access and session routing, cannot send there, and remains able to use an unrelated channel.
precise_assertions.admin_realtime_events: Two private-channel members receive exactly one topic and mode event each, carrying the verified administrator identity despite a forged setBy body. An outsider receives a separate authorized control event and no private event, and SQLite contains the requested topic and mode after runtime shutdown.

bugs.description: Authenticated hyphenated search returned 500 and SQLITE_ERROR no such column: replay in baseline; Sol fixed search and result-item privacy checks pass on bundle 03.
Admin kick returned success without KICK delivery and left session routing stale; bundle 03 verifies both recipients, outsider exclusion, routing removal and access denial.
Admin topic/mode changes lacked IRC events on baseline and WebSocket events on bundle 02; bundle 03 verifies both transports and outsider filtering.

limitations: Scenario titles and per-ID dispositions describe concrete assertions only; PARTIAL does not certify all required transports, state checks or universal assertions.
Additional authorized controls for every administrator handler branch have been delegated by the coordinator to task_e7a0b7672839 in a separate test file.
IRC operator role is granted and NickServ identification activates it before denial attempts; no independent OPER command exchange was used.
AUTH-030 entire pre-auth command allowlist, SCRAM vectors, all auth log secret exclusion, and all self-profile propagation transports remain uncovered.
DM-016 NOT IMPLEMENTED: IRC returns ERR_NOSUCHNICK for an offline recipient and inspected REST routes have no DM send operation; the executable observation is not a passing feature scenario.
DM message-by-ID REST read/write, unread, subscription and attachment endpoints are not demonstrated; group DM support is undetermined.
Delivery checks cover actual IRC and channel WebSocket events tested here, not every notification or event type.

Repository-wide TypeScript check remains red due to concurrent files outside this ownership: scripts/security-matrix-report.ts, tests/security/matrix-inventory.test.ts, and tests/security/matrix-persistence.test.ts; no errors were reported in owned files.
Other scenario IDs outside AUTH/ADMIN/USER/DM are outside this slice; runner deselected count is not a count of uncovered matrix scenarios.
